verdict.rationale: The Division documents its own retrieval of copies of filed business documents, UCC filings and certified searches, and lets entities dissolve, cancel or withdraw. That is a thin, piecemeal form of getting your records out and leaving. Nothing shows a complete account-wide export or any open or machine-readable format. Missing for 10: bulk export of all account/filing data, documented open or machine-readable formats (e.g., CSV/JSON/XML), an account-closure or data-portability process for the PBS account, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Search online to receive copies of business documents, including articles of incorporation, that are available in the New Jersey Public Record
Access the UCC records system and obtain status reports, certified searches and copies of filed financing statements
Request to dissolve, cancel or withdraw your LLC, LLP, LP, Corporation or Non-profit organization's authority in New Jersey
